svg.title: Drosophila chromosome complements
svg.desc: Two Drosophila chromosome complements, XX on the left and XY on the right. Both contain two copies each of chromosomes 2, 3 and 4: four long bent autosomes and two small dot chromosomes. The lower pair contains two X rods on the left, and one X rod and one hooked Y on the right. Each complement contains eight separate chromosomes. Aligned positions support comparison; they do not depict pairing or a cell-cycle phase. Schematic, not to scale.
